requested_outcome: Every real search is captured reliably, administrator tests are visible without contaminating public demand, and the management system provides a complete operational path from demand to an editable publishable page.
authorization_boundary: Local implementation, tests, branch commit and push are allowed by the active request. Production publication remains a distinct external action and must be verified after deployment.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user asked for the complete operational outcome rather than another partial screen.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The search must appear in its natural management destination and continue through editing and publication states.

lesson_bundle.reason: The management system must be simple to operate while preserving advanced capability.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Each screen gets one dominant task, clear status and progressive access to detail.

lesson_bundle.reason: A shared search-tracking defect affects all commercial worlds.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Regression covers vacation, events, spa and hourly result families.

lesson_bundle.reason: Source tests alone cannot prove the management workflow.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact routes, loading, empty, permission, persistence and reload states require browser evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user expects the changes in the live VII administration system.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Completion requires an immutable release identity and live verification, not only a pushed branch.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A search performed by the signed-in administrator still does not appear.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Permit authenticated administrator test capture even when public analytics consent is not granted, while discarding the same no-consent event for non-admin visitors.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A signed-in administrator search appears under a clearly separated tests view and public demand remains unchanged.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The dashboard shows only totals and does not reveal what was searched.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Expose recent intents, world, location, filters, results, source route, timestamp and direct editing action.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The management screen displays an actionable recent-search inventory and opens the matching page opportunity.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The new management interface still feels like disconnected cards rather than an operating system.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Connect overview, intelligence, approval queue, editor, publishing, sitemap and technical growth status through explicit next actions.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A manager can move from a search signal to the matching editing workspace without searching for another route.

predicted_rejections.prevention: Test the shared producer and each of the four commercial result families.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Vacation, events, spa and hourly emit the same bounded demand contract.

affected_family: D1 search demand and opportunity records

sources.label: VII accepted search and results behavior

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the ingestion contract and report model pass focused tests, before broad visual expansion.
checks: administrator no-consent test event is retained as internal
public demand counts exclude internal tests
recent intent rows resolve to a page opportunity

attack_questions: Can an administrator search disappear because consent is not set to all?
Can an internal test inflate public demand or the pending approval count?
Can the dashboard show a total without a route, filters or time that explains it?
Can an unauthorized visitor read search intelligence?
Does any commercial world fail to emit the detailed result event?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Live signed-in browser evidence on the exact VII administration routes after deployment.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused integration tests plus desktop and 390px browser checks for all changed routes.

effectiveness.baseline: The live version does not show the user's performed search; the current analytics page exposes aggregates only, and client capture stops entirely without full analytics consent.
effectiveness.target: One performed administrator search becomes visible in the separated tests surface within one refresh, without changing public-demand totals.
